expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Sets the editor palette category assigned to this widget class. Replaces the widget-tree root widget. Removes a widget from this widget tree. Adds the user widget to the game viewport at the requested Z order. Creates a user widget typed to WidgetClass for OwningPlayer in the current world.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
testScope: void UUserWidget.SetPaletteCategory(const FText& InPaletteCategory); | void UUserWidget.SetRootWidget(UWidget NewRootWidget); | bool UUserWidget.RemoveWidget(UWidget WidgetToRemove); | void UUserWidget.AddToViewport(int32 ZOrder = 0); | UUserWidget WidgetBlueprint::CreateWidget( const TSubclassOf<UUserWidget>& WidgetClass, APlayerController OwningPlayer);
